removed.description: Used for REMOVED events. Auto-disappears after 6 hours.

images.description: Subtle abstract blue/white background for login or empty states

rules: Ensure contrast ratio > 4.5:1 for normal text
Use data-testid on all interactive elements
Interactive elements must have visible focus states

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for dark colors.
Do not center align the app container.
Ensure 'Inter' font is used for body, 'Manrope' for headings.
Implement a clear visual distinction between New (Red) and Removed (Blue) events.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Dashboard with two columns for the two iCal feeds.
Use the specific color codes for New (Red) and Removed (Blue) events.
Add a 'Confirm' button (check icon) for Red events to turn them into Normal events.
Ensure Blue events automatically disappear after 6 hours (handle this logic in frontend or backend).
Create a Settings page for iCal URLs, Webpushr credentials, and Refresh Interval.
For the login page, use the provided abstract background image.
